scripts.use:paid: cp manifest.paid.yml manifest.yml && echo 'Active manifest: PAID'
scripts.use:free: cp manifest.free.yml manifest.yml && echo 'Active manifest: FREE'
scripts.ui:build:paid: cd static/forge-angular-app && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npx ng build --configuration production,paid --base-href ./ --deploy-url ./
scripts.ui:build:paid:watch: cd static/forge-angular-app && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npx ng build --watch --configuration development,paid --base-href ./ --deploy-url ./
scripts.ui:build:free: cd static/forge-angular-app && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npx ng build --configuration production,free --base-href ./ --deploy-url ./
scripts.ui:build:free:watch: cd static/forge-angular-app && NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider npx ng build --watch --configuration development,free --base-href ./ --deploy-url ./
